name: @ivan-boss/hse-harness
description: Personal study assistant with Telegram, Yandex Mail, calendars and Pi agent memory
author: ivan-boss

scripts.prepack: node scripts/prepare-bundle.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/create-runtime-manifest.mjs && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:package: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundle.mjs && node scripts/create-runtime-manifest.mjs && node --test test/package.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:quality && npm test && npm run test:runtime
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/e2e/run.mjs --calendar=icloud && node test/e2e/run.mjs --calendar=google && node test/e2e/run.mjs --calendar=yandex && node test/e2e/run.mjs --calendar=icloud --startup-pending
scripts.test:updates: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-bundle.mjs && node scripts/create-runtime-manifest.mjs && node --test test/npm-update.integration.test.mjs
scripts.lint: node scripts/code-policy.mjs && oxlint src test runtime scripts deploy bin
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src test runtime scripts deploy bin
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test runtime scripts deploy bin
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test runtime scripts deploy bin
